title: Lab setup
text:
LABLab setup · step by step

≈ 5 min

Set up the cart lab (vary mass)

01Level the track: a cart set at rest should not roll either way.

02Turn the sensor cart on. In Graphical Analysis, connect it by Bluetooth and turn on Position and Velocity.

03Clamp the pulley at the right end. Run the string from the cart over the pulley to a 50 g hanging mass.

04Keep the string level with the track. Put a soft catch at the pulley end.

05Each trial: add mass to the **cart**. Keep the hanging mass the same.

title: The asteroid thread
text:

What we know so far

2026-XJ has a mass of about 3.5 × 10¹¹ kg.

Today

To deflect it we need a huge force — or a small force over a long time. F = ma is the math behind every deflection strategy.

title: Procedure and safe release
text:
LABInvestigation 1.2

Target S3 Lab

Procedure and safe release

•Measure cart and hanger masses in kg. Secure added masses. Level the track.

•Leave space for the hanger to fall and a soft stop before the cart reaches the pulley.

•Release without pushing. Fit a straight section of v–t data while the hanger is still falling.

•Repeat three times for each of at least three total masses.

•Record all trials and note failed releases separately.
